facts.fact: A sealed regent's order ('burn the cough') carried by the patrol captain overrides Varun's wish to hold the village intact: the marked houses are to be fired tonight, killing the sick and those who tended them, who have seen the regent's grain sacks.
facts.why: needed because the beat has the guards discuss firing Ranu tonight to burn the cough and its witnesses, and F227 has Varun needing the village intact.

facts.fact: The lie-cold on Meera's left hand rises past the knuckles toward the wrist beneath the iron forearm band; her thumb, first and middle fingers still move.
facts.why: needed to show the extent of the great lie's damage on the page.

facts.fact: The soldier with the wet cough who locked Rohan's cuffs guards the lockhouse door alongside another soldier, and refers to Pasang's account of the sealed order.
facts.why: needed to give the guards' overheard talk a source.
